sections.title: 1. Purpose
body: These terms govern the use of Kron: the Discord bot, the kronbot.xyz web panel and related services (the “Service”), operated by the Kron team (“we”). By adding Kron to a Discord server, using its commands, filling in a form or logging in to the panel, you accept these terms. If you don't, do not use the Service.

sections.title: 2. Definitions
body: “Server”: a Discord server where Kron is added. “Administrator”: a person who adds or configures Kron on a Server (Manage Server or Administrator permission). “Member”: anyone interacting with Kron on a Server or through a form. “Module”: a Kron feature enabled per Server (tickets, whitelist, logs, etc.).

sections.title: 3. Eligibility
body: You must meet Discord's minimum age in your country and hold a Discord account in good standing. In Québec, a person under 14 may not provide personal information to the Service (for example by filling in a form) without the consent of a parent or guardian.
If you use the Service on behalf of an organization, you represent that you may bind it.

sections.title: 4. Relationship with Discord
body: Kron is an independent product. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Discord Inc. Your use of Discord remains subject to Discord's Terms of Service, Community Guidelines and Developer Policy. The Service depends on Discord: an outage or change at Discord may affect it without liability on our part.

sections.title: 5. Administrator responsibilities
body: Administrators choose which Modules are enabled and how. They are responsible for:
• their Server complying with Discord rules and applicable laws;
• the questions in their forms and how they use the answers: they must tell Members why information is collected, obtain consent where required and only ask for what is necessary;
• never asking, through a form, ticket or any Module, for passwords, banking data, identity documents or health information;
• decisions made on their Server (accepting or denying applications, sanctions, role assignments, etc.).
For information collected from their Members, the Administrator determines the purposes and we act as a service provider on their behalf.

sections.title: 6. Acceptable use
body: You may not use the Service to:
• break any law or Discord rules, or infringe the rights of others;
• harass, threaten, share hateful content, sexual content involving minors or incitement to violence;
• send spam, mass unsolicited messages or malicious links;
• impersonate anyone, Kron or Discord, or phish users;
• circumvent the Service’s limits, security or billing, attack or overload it, or scrape data from it;
• decompile or copy the Service, except as permitted by law.
We may limit, suspend or remove Kron from a Server, or block a user, who breaks these rules, with or without notice depending on severity.

sections.title: 7. Content
body: You keep your rights in the content you provide (configured messages, form answers, etc.). You grant us a limited, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to host, process and display it, solely to provide the Service. You represent that you have the right to provide it. We do not monitor Server content, but we may remove content that breaks these terms.

sections.title: 8. Paid plans
body: Some features are offered by subscription: Pro and Whitelabel, per Server, monthly, yearly or once for life, at the prices shown on the Site when you buy. Prices are in US dollars; applicable taxes are extra. Payments are processed by Stripe; we never store your card data.

Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each term, at the same price, unless cancelled. You can cancel at any time: cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid term and you keep access until then.
Any price increase will be announced at least 30 days in advance and only applies to the next term. Except where required by law, started terms are not refundable.
When a Whitelabel subscription ends, the Server returns to the standard Kron after a 7-day grace period; configurations are kept.

sections.title: 9. Availability and changes
body: The Service is provided “as is” and “as available”. We make reasonable efforts to keep it running, but do not guarantee it will be uninterrupted or error-free. We may change, add or remove features. If a paid feature is removed, we will offer an equivalent solution or a prorated refund.

sections.title: 10. Termination
body: You may stop using the Service at any time, including by removing Kron from your Server. We may end access for a Server or user that breaks these terms. Data is then kept and destroyed according to the Privacy Policy; you can request deletion at any time.

sections.title: 11. Intellectual property
body: The Kron name, logo, code, design and documentation belong to us. These terms transfer no rights in them, except the right to use the Service in accordance with them.

sections.title: 12. Limitation of liability
body: To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages, loss of data, profits or goodwill, or for the actions of Administrators, Members or Discord. Our total liability is limited to the amounts you paid us in the last 12 months.
Nothing in these terms limits your rights under Québec's Consumer Protection Act or any other mandatory law.

sections.title: 13. Privacy
body: How we collect and use personal information is described in our Privacy Policy, which forms part of these terms.

sections.title: 14. Changes
body: We may change these terms. A material change will be announced at least 30 days in advance on kronbot.xyz and on our Discord support server. Continuing to use the Service after it takes effect means you accept it; otherwise you may stop using it and cancel your subscription.

sections.title: 15. Governing law and language
body: These terms are governed by the laws of Québec and the applicable federal laws of Canada. Disputes fall under the courts of Québec, subject to a consumer’s right to sue in their home district. The French version prevails over any translation.

sections.title: 16. Contact
body: Fastest: open a ticket on our Discord server (kronbot.xyz/support). By email: dev@kronbot.xyz.

sections.title: 1. Our commitment
body: This policy explains what personal information Kron collects, why, how it is protected and what your rights are. It is written to comply with Québec's Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector (Law 25) and Canada's PIPEDA.

sections.title: 2. Person in charge of personal information
body: The person in charge of the protection of personal information is the owner of Kron. For any question, request or complaint: dev@kronbot.xyz, with “Privacy” in the subject.

sections.title: 3. Information we collect
body: Panel account (Discord login): your Discord ID, username, display name, avatar and preferred language. Your Discord access tokens, encrypted.
Session security: the IP address and browser (user agent) of your session, and server technical logs.
Discord servers: the ID, name, language and Module configuration of each Server Kron is in.

Module data, only if an Administrator enables it: form answers (whitelist, recruitment), ticket question answers, birthday date, reminders, moderation history, giveaway entries, invite tracking (who invited whom), role backups (which roles each member has, kept as the last 80 snapshots).

FiveM bridge, if an Administrator installs it: FiveM license, player name and Discord ID of connected players; on staff request, characters’ name, job, phone and money (each field can be turned off); messages sent with /report.

Rocket League, if a member uses /rl lier: the game account platform and name or ID, linked to their Discord ID, until they use /rl delier. Kron also keeps readings of their ranks, MMR and career stats (read from the rocket-league10 API) to show the history, for 60 days.
Diagnostics: the $debug command produces a report (server, channel and user names and IDs, bot permissions) sent to our support server.
Payments: card details are collected directly by Stripe; we only receive a customer ID and the subscription status.

sections.title: 4. What we do not collect
body: We do not ask Discord for your email address, we have no access to your private messages, and we do not store your server list (it is read from Discord when needed). The Logs module shows deleted or edited message content in the Server’s channels: that content is kept in memory for at most 1 hour and is never written to our database.

sections.title: 5. Purposes
body: We use this information only to: provide and secure the Service; authenticate you and check your permissions; run the Modules enabled by Administrators; provide support; handle billing; prevent abuse and meet our legal obligations. We do not sell your information and do not do targeted advertising.

sections.title: 6. Consent
body: You consent to collection when you log in to the panel, use a command or send a form. You may withdraw consent at any time (see section 11); some features may then become unavailable. A minor under 14 may not provide information without the consent of a parent or guardian.

sections.title: 7. Sharing
body: Information is shared only as needed:
• with the Administrators of the Server concerned (for example, form answers are visible to the team reviewing them);
• with our providers: Discord (bot operation and login), Cloudflare (site protection, bot checks), our cloud hosting provider and Stripe (payments);
• with authorities, where the law requires it.
Our providers are contractually bound to protect the information and may not use it for other purposes.

sections.title: 8. Hosting and transfers outside Québec
body: Our servers are hosted by a cloud provider in the United States, and Discord, Cloudflare and Stripe process data outside Québec. Before any transfer, we assess whether the information will receive adequate protection, as required by law.

sections.title: 9. Retention and destruction
body: Sessions: 7 days of inactivity. Technical logs: 7 days. Message cache (Logs module): 1 hour, in memory only.
$debug reports: 90 days, viewable through a unique link (kronbot.xyz/d/…), then deleted automatically.
Panel account: while you use it; logging out revokes your Discord tokens. Module data: as long as the Administrator keeps it or until a deletion request.
Data of a Server Kron was removed from: deleted automatically 30 days after removal, or sooner on request. The Server's paid Pro plan is kept. Billing data: as long as tax laws require.
When retention ends, information is securely destroyed or anonymized.

sections.title: 10. Security
body: We protect information with reasonable measures: encrypted connections (HTTPS), encrypted Discord tokens (AES-256-GCM), sessions stored as hashes, restricted server access, bot and attack protection. No system is perfectly secure; if a confidentiality incident presents a risk of serious injury, we will notify the Commission d’accès à l’information and the people concerned, and we keep an incident register.

sections.title: 11. Your rights
body: You may request access to your information, its correction, its deletion, its transfer in a structured, commonly used technological format (portability), and withdraw your consent. Email dev@kronbot.xyz; we will answer within 30 days. We may verify your identity (for example through your Discord account). For data collected by a Server, we may refer you to its Administrator.
If you are not satisfied with our answer, you may file a complaint with the Commission d’accès à l’information du Québec (cai.gouv.qc.ca).

sections.title: 12. Cookies and local storage
body: We only use essential cookies: one session cookie and a temporary cookie during login. Your theme and language are kept in your browser. We use no advertising, analytics or tracking cookies.

sections.title: 13. Changes
body: We may update this policy. The effective date is shown at the top; a material change will be announced on kronbot.xyz and on our Discord server.

tools.title: Discord tools

snowflake.name: ❄️ ID decoder
snowflake.text: Every Discord ID (snowflake) holds its creation date. Paste a user, server, channel or message ID.

timestamp.name: 🕒 Timestamp generator
timestamp.text: Pick a date and time: copy the code, Discord shows it in each reader’s time zone and language.
timestamp.hint: Paste the code in any message or embed.

user.name: 👤 User lookup
user.text: Public profile of a Discord account from its ID: avatar, banner, badges, creation date.
user.hint: Discord developer mode → right-click a member → Copy User ID.

server.name: 🏠 Server lookup
server.text: Public info of a server from an invite: name, icon, banner, members, boosts, features.

media.name: 🖼️ Emojis and stickers
media.text: Download an emoji or a sticker in high resolution.
media.hint: In Discord, send \:emoji: to get its <:name:id> code.

permissions.name: 🔐 Permission calculator
permissions.text: Tick permissions to get their value, or paste a value to see what it holds. Also builds a bot invite link.
permissions.clientId: Application ID (optional, for the invite link)

fonts.name: 🔤 Unicode fonts
fonts.text: Write in bold, italic, mono, small caps… and paste it in a nickname, a channel or a message.
